# Nouradawy — Full-Stack & Mobile Systems Engineer
> Portfolio & Technical Index: https://www.nouradawy.tech/

This file is optimized for consumption by AI agents (Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) and developer tooling.

## Primary Projects & Systems

- [WhatsUnity Residential OS](/whatsunity.md): One home. One subscription. Your entire household included. WhatsUnity turns your compound into a connected, secure, digitally managed community. Built with Flutter and Clean Architecture, featuring unit-verified resident directories, 100% offline cryptographic QR gatekeeping, dual-engine messaging, and an end-to-end 5-role engineering maintenance lifecycle.
- [Portfolio Source & Architecture](https://www.nouradawy.tech/): High-performance portfolio showcasing full-stack mobile, backend, and web systems built with Flutter, React 19, Vite, TanStack Router, Appwrite, and Supabase.

## Key Technical Proficiencies

- **Mobile & Architecture**: Flutter (Dart 3, Clean Architecture, BLoC/Cubit, Sealed Classes, Zero Code-Gen), Android (Kotlin), iOS, SQLite Local Master, Hive.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Appwrite Cloud & Self-Hosted, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Spring Boot (Java), Node.js, Cloudflare R2 Edge Object Storage.
- **Security & Protocols**: Cryptographic QR Validation, AES-256 GCM, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), WebSocket Realtime, Telegram MTProto API.
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
